title: Giving Opinions & Agreeing/Disagreeing
grammarNotes: 'Creo que' and 'pienso que' take the indicative when affirmative ('creo que tienes razón') but flip to subjunctive when negated: 'no creo que sea tan sencillo' — negating the opinion verb casts doubt on the whole clause.
'Dudar que' works the same way as a negated opinion verb: doubt always triggers subjunctive, even though 'dudar' itself is a plain, non-negated verb — the doubt is baked into its meaning.
'Es posible que' and similar impersonal expressions of possibility take subjunctive by default, unlike 'es verdad que' or 'es cierto que,' which state something as fact and keep the indicative.

words.en: to be wrong / make a mistake

phrases.en: What do you think about this?

phrases.es: En mi opinión, es una mala idea
phrases.en: In my opinion, it's a bad idea

phrases.es: No estoy de acuerdo en absoluto
Dudo mucho que eso sea cierto
No pienso que sea buena idea
phrases.en: I don't think it's a good idea

phrases.es: Yo lo veo de otra manera
No hay que discutir por esto
phrases.en: There's no need to argue over this

phrases.es: Cada quien tiene su propia opinión
Estoy convencido de que va a funcionar
phrases.en: I'm convinced it's going to work
I agree with you on that point
I'd rather not comment on that

sentences.es: En mi opinión, deberíamos esperar antes de tomar una decisión.
sentences.en: In my opinion, we should wait before making a decision.

sentences.es: Con todo respeto, señor presidente, no comparto esa visión.
sentences.en: With all due respect, Mr. President, I don't share that view.

sentences.es: Che, yo creo que te equivocas, pero bueno, es tu decisión.
sentences.en: Hey, I think you're wrong, but well, it's your decision.

sentences.es: Dudo mucho que ese plan funcione tal como lo describen.
sentences.en: I really doubt that plan will work the way they describe it.

sentences.es: Le agradecería que expusiera su punto de vista con más detalle.
sentences.en: I'd appreciate it if you laid out your point of view in more detail.

sentences.es: La verdad, no pienso que valga la pena discutir por algo tan tonto.
sentences.en: Honestly, I don't think it's worth arguing over something so silly.

sentences.es: Según los datos, la mayoría de la gente está de acuerdo con la propuesta.
sentences.en: According to the data, most people agree with the proposal.

sentences.es: Estimados colegas, me gustaría escuchar sus opiniones antes de continuar.
sentences.en: Dear colleagues, I'd like to hear your opinions before we continue.

sentences.es: Uy, yo lo veo totalmente distinto, pero respeto tu opinión.
sentences.en: Oh, I see it totally differently, but I respect your opinion.

sentences.es: No creo que sea tan sencillo como lo estás planteando.
sentences.en: I don't think it's as simple as you're making it out to be.

sentences.es: Permítame disentir, creo que hay otros factores que considerar.
sentences.en: Allow me to disagree, I think there are other factors to consider.

sentences.es: Tienes razón, la verdad no lo había pensado de esa manera.
sentences.en: You're right, honestly I hadn't thought about it that way.

sentences.es: Es posible que ambos tengamos parte de razón en esto.
sentences.en: It's possible we're both partly right about this.

sentences.es: Agradecemos sus comentarios, aunque no coincidimos del todo con su análisis.
sentences.en: We appreciate your comments, although we don't entirely agree with your analysis.

sentences.es: Al final cambié de opinión después de escuchar tus argumentos.
sentences.en: In the end I changed my mind after hearing your arguments.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Oye, o sea, no sé, yo creo que deberíamos cambiar de proveedor.
dialogue.en: Hey, I mean, I don't know, I think we should switch suppliers.

dialogue.speaker: felipe
dialogue.es: Mmm, pues yo no estoy tan de acuerdo, o sea, el actual nos ha funcionado bien.
dialogue.en: Mmm, well I don't quite agree, I mean, the current one has worked well for us.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Bueno, sí, pero últimamente ha habido varios retrasos, ¿no crees?
dialogue.en: Well, yes, but there have been several delays lately, don't you think?

dialogue.speaker: felipe
dialogue.es: Tienes razón en eso, o sea, tal vez valga la pena buscar otras opciones.
dialogue.en: You're right about that, I mean, maybe it's worth looking at other options.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Exacto, pues eso digo, no perdemos nada con comparar precios.
dialogue.en: Exactly, well that's what I'm saying, we lose nothing by comparing prices.

dialogue.speaker: felipe
dialogue.es: Va, me convenciste, busquemos un par de alternativas esta semana.
dialogue.en: Okay, you convinced me, let's look for a couple of alternatives this week.
